item.title: What Property Managers Want Investors to Know About Inflation and Rent Growth
item.description: Inflation isn’t just a headline you skim past. If you think about it, inflation affects every part of the business of property management, from your day-to-day operating expenses for utilities and maintenance to your rent decisions. As an investor, you may think that rising inflation means rents should rise accordingly. For property managers, however, it’s not nearly as straightforward; there are several other factors at play.

item.title: The Hollywood Celebrities with the Longest Longterm Relationships
item.description: Most marriages in the entertainment industry end before the 10-year mark. Public pressure, long separations during filming, and constant media attention create conditions that strain even committed partners. Yet a small group of couples has remained together for decades, building quiet lives alongside their public careers.
